# Noblesse Oblige — Artifact Set Reference

- **Max Rarity**: ★★★★★

## 2-Piece Bonus
Elemental Burst DMG +20%

## 4-Piece Bonus
Using an Elemental Burst increase all party members' ATK by 20% for 12s. This effect cannot stack.
